Depends on if these thoughts are becoming intrusive and affecting your day to day life.

Have you started adopting any habits or rituals to make these thoughts go away?

Everyone has weird thoughts from time to time, some of which would, if acted upon, lead to dangerous or socially unacceptable outcomes. It is quite normal to have these thoughts: it's just your brain running "what if" scenarios, and checking that your understanding of the world matches how the world actually is.

For example, lots of people will think about insulting other people, and then think "That's odd, I'm not the sort of person who insults people." This is just your brain checking through the "I'm not the sort of person who insults people" aspect of your personality, to make sure that it's still valid. That's why a moment after you have the thought, you follow it up with another thought saying "It would be dreadful if I did that. I'm glad I didn't." It's just your brain making sure that everything works properly.
